What We Offer

One center.
Every way to train.

Most gyms give you a weights room and wish you luck. Jasabi is set up differently — a strength floor for lifters, a turf track for athletic work, a spin studio, an indoor pool, and badminton courts, all in one center off Peter Odili Road. Pick your discipline, or mix them through the week.

  • Strength / Bodybuilding
  • Personal Training
  • Turf Training
  • Cardio
  • Cycling / Spin Studio
  • Women’s Spin Class
  • Indoor Swimming Pool
  • Aqua-Aerobics
  • Badminton Courts

Classes & Facilities

Train your way

Six training spaces, one address. However you like to move — heavy, fast, in the water or on the court — there is a floor for it at Jasabi.

01

Strength & Bodybuilding

The heart of the center. Free weights, barbells and plate-loaded machines for structured strength work and bodybuilding — whether it is your first programme or your next personal best.

Ask about strength training
02

Cycling / Spin Studio

High-energy indoor cycling sessions in a dedicated studio — including a women’s spin class. Low impact on the joints, high burn on the legs.

Ask about classes
03

Indoor Pool & Aqua-Aerobics

An indoor swimming pool for laps, recovery days and low-impact conditioning — plus aqua-aerobics classes that build fitness in the water.

Ask about the pool
04

Turf Training

A marked turf track for sled pushes, sprints and functional conditioning — the space for athletic, full-body work away from the machines.

Ask about turf training
05

Badminton Courts

Dedicated indoor badminton courts — for sharp footwork, fast rallies, and a training day that feels like a game. Bring a partner or find one here.

Ask about court time
06

Personal Training & Cardio

One-on-one personal training for a programme built around your goals, and a cardio area for the engine work that supports everything else you do.

Ask about personal training

On the class schedule

Spin sessions, a women’s spin class and aqua-aerobics run as classes at the center. Class times are confirmed when you enquire — send a message and ask about the current schedule.

Membership

Start with a conversation

Membership at Jasabi starts with an enquiry, not a checkout page. Tell us how you want to train and the team will walk you through the current membership options and what each one includes.

1

Send an Enquiry

Use the form below or message the center on Instagram. Say what you are interested in — membership, personal training, classes, the pool or the courts.

2

Hear Your Options

The team confirms the current membership options, what is included, and the class schedule — so you can choose based on how you actually train.

3

Get to Work

Step onto the floor, the turf, the bike, the court or into the pool — and start building the habit.

No prices are listed on this preview. Membership rates change and depend on the option you choose, so they are confirmed directly by the center when you enquire.
